name: monk-storybook

palette.notes: Butter-yellow light, sage-green walls, warm brown robe/wood, dark ink outlines. Earlier darker palette: #F1EADA #5C5047 #1D1916 #A26A35.

character.monk: Vector rig in presets/film-snapshot/modules/shared.js -> W.monk / W.bindMonk / W.poseMonk. Pose keys: x y s lean head sq a1 a2 a3 b legL legR bob mouth blink.

motion_rules_from_reference: 4-pose stepped walk at 8 fps with a bob on the down beat (W.step)
constant-speed right-to-left pan with 3 parallax layers (~40% / 70% / 100%)
literal visual gag on the key narration word, timed to the word
pose-to-pose arm hits: small anticipation, overshoot (eob 1.5-1.8)
captions on a parchment card, words rising 110 ms apart
sound effect on every action: footsteps, whoosh, pop, thud
content_rules: Violence shown only through setup and silhouettes; no gore.
